task.title: List, template and narrow project options for --all-options
task.problem: Projects with many options exceed the --all-options cap, and pinning each option with -o is tedious and drops the sources other values reach.
task.proposal: Add --list-options and --options-template to show every toplevel option with its type, default and values, and --options-file where a value pins an option and a list limits --all-options to those values.
acceptance: --list-options and --options-template work without a target and reflect -o and --options-file.
The template lists every option commented out with its values; uncommenting entries yields a valid options file.
A file value pins an option; a list (list of sets for flags/element-mask) limits --all-options; -o overrides the file; invalid names or values fail before loading.
Without --all-options, one-value lists pin and longer lists are rejected; existing searches without these options are unchanged.
evidence: Unit tests in tests/test_option_space.py and the template/file round trip in test_all_options_searches_union_of_option_sets pass against BuildStream 2.8.1.

Review of 30de0f4: templates keep an options file's restrictions and quote values YAML-safely; regression tests for load-render-load and commas, brackets, hashes, quotes, backslashes, newlines and empty values.
